statements.t: Eventually, the oil and gas reserves under the Company’s current land holdings will be depleted.
Upon completion, JPE will become the Company’s controlling stockholder, Brad Jacobs will become Chairman and Chief Executive Officer, and the Board of Directors will be reconstituted.
The investment is expected to close in early 2027, subject to approval by the Company’s stockholders, receipt of necessary antitrust approvals and other customary closing conditions.

NewCo will be the issuer of the preferred stock and warrants, and references in this Quarterly Report on Form 10-Q to the Company with respect to periods following the holding company reorganization refer to NewCo.

Also pursuant to the Investment Agreement, the Company’s stockholders as of the date on which the holding company reorganization becomes effective will be entitled to receive an aggregate cash dividend of $20,800,660, to be paid seven days after such date (the “Cash Dividend”).

The Company identified demand in those areas for ranchette-style lots, which consist of more than three acres each, and the Board of Directors and management believed the project would allow the Company to realize a return on its investment in the applicable lands after payment of expenses.
As a result, the Company no longer owns any lots in these subdivisions and does not expect any further lot sales.
In the opinion of management, cash and cash equivalents are adequate for projected operations and possible land acquisitions.
